onlyCandidateDelta.before: 不看 rows 估算 → 不知道扫描了多少行
onlyCandidateDelta.after: 忽略 rows 估算会误判扫描成本；估算也不等于实际扫描行数，要结合执行统计核对。

integrationRule: First verify the original whole-entry hash, then prove the sole candidate delta equals the separate root qualification; replay every before-value/absence guard. Do not drop or silently replace the original guard.
